_meta.purpose: Frozen gold set for deterministic-digest-scoring shadow gate (SPEC §6a). Apollo pre-labels; ACE RATIFIES. Versioned in-repo so shadow runs are reproducible.

label_semantics.known_good: ideal placement is TOP or ALSO (must score >= ALSO_GATE; known_good in TOP must not be displaced by known_bad)
label_semantics.known_bad: spam / fragment / off-topic / engagement-farmed — must NEVER reach TOP
label_semantics.neutral: benign but low-value — must NOT appear in TOP; no ordering constraint

shadow_pass_bar: Bar1: no known_bad has final >= TOP_GATE (score-framed, D-11)
Bar2: every known_good has final >= ALSO_GATE (score-framed)
Bar3: no neutral has final >= TOP_GATE (score-framed)
Bar4: no known_bad's final exceeds any known_good's final (anti-inversion)
_meta.status: DRAFT — awaiting Ace ratification of each label
_meta.bar_strength: Bars 1 & 3 structurally-satisfied on this fixture (known_bad/neutral floor-pinned); Bars 2 & 4 are the load-bearing nets. See PRD D-4.

items.label: neutral
items.why: real builder, genuinely interesting, but 2 likes = no crowd signal; should NOT have hit 100/TOP. Acceptable as ALSO at most, not TOP. The headline regression case.
items.label_rationale: Real hands-on agent field report (trace-db debugging, resumable eval runs) — genuinely on-topic & substantive, but only 2 likes. The LABELS are correct; the low-reach cap (2 likes, unknown-ish reach) is what must keep it out of TOP, NOT a bad label. neutral overall because no crowd signal.
